gold: Primary invasive lobular breast carcinoma in heterotopic cutaneous breast tissue

selector.rationale: Hidradenocarcinoma is supported by the presence of GATA3-positive and estrogen receptor–positive apocrine glands in close association to diffuse tumor cell infiltration, which is a distinctive feature of this disease.

rejected.label: Extramammary Paget Disease
rejected.why: While it shares some histological features with the presented case, the presence of apocrine glands and specific immunohistochemical markers points more strongly towards Hidradenocarcinoma.
